units: Sabb. VIII, 7 כדי ליתן בין פ׳ לחבירו as much as is required between one board and another (when they are piled up).—[Maasr. I, 7 הפצים, v. פַּץ.]—Esp. the board nailed against the wall to form a door-frame, door-post.
<cite ref="Menachot 34a:4">Men. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>בית שאין לו אלא פ׳ אחד</he> a room which has only one door-post (the corner wall serving for the other post).
<cite ref="Menachot 33b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>לפי שאין לה פ׳</he> because it (the exedra) has no door-frame.
<cite ref="Menachot 33b:10">Ib.</cite> <he>עדי פצימו</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>פצימין</he>, read: <cite ref="Q01433"><he>פַּצִּימָיו</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="P00135"><he>עָדֵי</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 12a:2">B. Bath. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>פרץ את פַּצִימָיו</he> if he broke open its door-frame (opened again a walled up entrance).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:7:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ</cite> <he>מפרק את פצימיו</he> he takes out its door-posts; a. e.
